summary: Supabase has two new AI-tooling engineering roles on its Ashby board, open worldwide with no office (TypeScript, Postgres, eval frameworks; the second leans to infra and on-call). postings.title: Software Engineer - AI Tooling
postings.why: AI developer tooling for the Supabase Postgres platform (assistant, MCP, eval frameworks for AI quality); TypeScript/JavaScript, Postgres; fully remote company with no offices.
postings.gap: "Have 5+ years of experience in professional software engineering"; "Have designed or used evaluation frameworks to measure AI quality, reliability and task success" (no eval work in the CV); "Have built developer tools, product interfaces or platform primitives used by other engineers"; "Write strong TypeScript and know the JavaScript ecosystem well"; annual week-long company off-site

pay_estimate.basis: No compensation on the Ashby board (read 2026-11-16). Market only, as cited in sweep 2026-11-08T0108Z: levels.fyi Software Engineer Germany median total comp EUR 84.8k, p75 102k; JobRise 'Junior vs Senior Developer Gehalt 2026' Senior Backend EUR 85-125k. A funded global-remote devtools company, so the point sits above the Germany median; range wide because Supabase's location policy is unknown. Review 2026-11-16: JobRise article re-opened; it also gives 'Remote EU für internationale Firma: EUR 100k bis 150k' and 'Senior Backend Developer ... EUR 85k bis 125k'; levels.fyi Germany median (search snippet, Nov 2025) USD 91.8k = EUR 83k at 0.9066. Max widened to 150k for the remote-EU band; point unchanged.

pay_estimate.basis: No figure in the ad. Market only, as cited in sweep 2026-11-08T0108Z: levels.fyi Software Engineer Germany median total comp EUR 84.8k, p25 70.5k; StepStone Senior Full Stack Developer Germany median EUR 54.7k (46.7-65.2k). The ad asks for 4+ years and the client is an unnamed mid-size software house, so the point sits below the levels.fyi median. Review 2026-11-16: StepStone Senior Full Stack Developer Germany re-checked (avg EUR 54.7k, 46.7-65.2k); JobRise 2026 Mittelstand senior EUR 75-95k, Munich mid-level 68-88k. The sources disagree, so min widened to 55k and point lowered to 72k; the ad states only 'Fachkraft' and 4+ years, no level.
